# Android SDK Setup Guide (Kotlin)

Source: https://docs.linkzly.com/docs/sdk-android

The Linkzly Android SDK tracks installs, opens, and custom events; handles standard URL schemes, App Links, and deferred deep linking; records revenue events; captures affiliate attribution from incoming links; registers the device's push token; and includes a dedicated gaming event pipeline.

The SDK is written in Kotlin, callable from Java (the public methods are `@JvmStatic`), lifecycle-aware, and ships consumer ProGuard/R8 rules.
